## Highlights

- [Automation tests](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/automations/testing) now run from the editor with per-test failures and path coverage. Try the draft or an individual step, save a run as a regression test, and see test counts on saved versions and deployments.
- [Chat can make downloadable files and use skills](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/chat/files-and-skills) from your library. Text files need no sandbox; documents, spreadsheets and charts use a light sandbox when code is needed.
- Person-started [standard agent tasks](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/projects/project-agents#standard-agent-runs) can make files and search knowledge on the shared chat engine without starting a full workspace. Work needing a repository, browser or hours hands over to the agent's full workspace with its brief and files.
- [OpenAI subscription credentials](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/admin/providers#paste-an-openai-chatgpt-subscription-token) can carry the ChatGPT account identity Codex harness runs need in tasks and automations.
- [Resumed harness task turns](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4845) receive their current execution identity, and resumed Codex turns receive the current organization and agent guidance. Retries and restarts open with this update before the task brief, even when the conversation retained older guidance.
- After a successful [deployment recovery](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4842), removing the takeover declaration allows configuration-only updates without an unnecessary runtime rollout when the retained receipt proves the unchanged basis.
- Admins can [set retention for automation versions](https://docs.tale.dev/self-hosted/configuration/retention), keeping versions needed by live deployments, runs, recent history and legal holds.
- [Historical package publication](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4846) can fill missing `ui-vX.Y.Z` and `marketing-ui-vX.Y.Z` tags from their immutable release source without rewinding `dist/ui` or `dist/marketing-ui`. Publication uses maintained tooling and reads historical source as data.

## Upgrade notes

- The backend applies migrations `0200_automation_test_reports.sql`, `0201_provider_subscription_account_id.sql` and `0202_agent_run_engine.sql` at boot. The first two add nullable fields; earlier test verdicts remain readable without a detailed report. Migration 0202 adds a non-null engine defaulting to `harness`, keeping existing runs and old-image inserts on that route during a roll, plus nullable transcript/handoff fields and a native-run index. No manual data backfill is required. Include them in the normal deployment and database backup procedure.
- To use an OpenAI **Subscription key**, provide its **ChatGPT account ID**; OpenAI broker tokens must supply the vendor's `account_id`. Restrict models to those your subscription supports and verify a Codex harness task. Subscriptions use their provider-bound harnesses in tasks and automations; the native engine requires an API-key or environment credential.
- With **Agent runtime** on **Automatic**, person-started standard agents can use the native engine. Starts by automations, schedules or other agents use the full workspace, as do custom agents and runs with equipped connectors, platform tools or secrets, subscription models or pinned runtimes. To require it from the start, [pin the standard agent's runtime](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/admin/governance/content-models#standard-agent). Each organization runs at most four native task runs concurrently; further native runs queue. Full-workspace workers keep their configured **Agent workers** limits.
- Review [Chat tools](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/admin/governance/policies-and-limits#chat-tools) before rollout: **Files**, **Skills** and **Code** default to on and govern chat only. The new [Light sandboxes](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/admin/sandboxes#light-sandboxes) quota defaults to two per organization, is shared by chat and native task code, and counts toward allocated capacity. Clients reading chat messages must accept the additive `artifact` part in API contract `3.36.0`.
- Automation-version cleanup stays off until an admin enables it. Review and apply retention bounds before enabling deletion; older organization files use bundled bounds for the new category until you add their own. Cleanup preserves the live version, the last ten deployments' versions, versions used by runs, the newest twenty, the versions those were based on or restored from, and legal holds.
- After bundle recovery reaches Ready, remove `supersedesPendingBundle` and prepare again before a configuration-only apply. Preserve the Ready receipt and recovery snapshot. New pending rollouts allow at most 64 takeovers; legacy journals with 65 entries remain recoverable. At the limit, recover the exact pending bundle before selecting another rollout.
- Adopt the service images and CLI as one validated cohort. [Release publication](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/blob/main/.github/RELEASING.md) admits one new full cohort per UTC day and permits same-version recovery. Retry or backfill package tags from `main` with both `release_tag` and the tag's full `source_sha`; identical existing tags are kept, and conflicting tags require reconciliation without moving them.
